checks.counts_note: These scopes overlap; the counts are not a total of unique tests. The independent review inspected the author evidence and ran its own seven focused cases.

verified_with_inert_adapters: A queued old pause event does not cancel a newer explicit Play while the audio element is currently unpaused; genuine pause still cancels, and stale playing while paused is ignored.
Closing during a pending manifest load invalidates that request, so its late result cannot reopen the library or interrupt resumed walking. A later explicit Open remains possible.
Focused Escape closes the library. Panel focus clears held movement keys and pointer input; walking resumes only through an explicit action.
Room exit and reentry invalidate a pending open. Package changes and page disposal clean up the old panel and controller.
All six chapters preserve their exact transcripts and source links, retain audio:null, disable Play and make no real audio playback call.
Official source URL admission and textContent rendering remain intact. Historical, current and planned material remains dated.
limits: DOM, renderer and media behavior was exercised with inert test adapters, not a real browser or audio decoder.
Private exported world packages are absent; the exact package admission hashes are preserved, not broadened.
Future narration needs verified audio files, pronunciation, duration and listening review before it can be offered as playable.
The current library is a desktop integration. Independent page and XR visibility composition and headset interaction remain future work.
This summary is a sanitized derivation of the pinned independent review, not a publication or installation approval.
